correctStatements.text: At 14:05 Priya reported that search API p99 latency had jumped to 2.8 seconds against a usual level of roughly 300 milliseconds.
At 14:09 Tomasz took ownership and found that a reindex job begun at 13:55 local time was heavily loading the shard nodes.
Support reported that roughly 20 percent of searches returned an empty results page.
At 14:14 Tomasz chose to pause the reindex instead of killing it, which preserved the partial progress.
At 14:18 Priya confirmed the reindex was paused and that heap usage on shard-3 stood at 91 percent.
At 14:26 Yuki restarted shard-3, which then began rejoining the cluster.
Tomasz traced the load to the indexing batch size, which had been raised from 500 to 5000 the week before.
At 14:33 Priya observed p99 latency return to 340 milliseconds with the empty result pages gone.
At 14:40 Hassan closed the incident after ten minutes without new customer reports.
Tomasz will cap the reindex batch size at 1000 in the job configuration.
Yuki will add an alert for shard heap usage above 85 percent.
Priya summarised that oversized reindex batches overloaded the shard nodes and degraded search for about 28 minutes.
